name: &TEAM Gakuen
overview: &TEAM Gakuen (&TEAM学園, andTEAM学園 or &TEAM 학원; also known as andTeam Gakuen and &TEAM Academy; titled &TEAM学園 2学期 for the second season) is a variety series starring &TEAM. The series features the members of &TEAM in different games, challenges or activities with differents guest each episode.
